To whom it may concern

I have known Uzoamaka Ezenwa-Clarke for eleven years, first as her tutor and later as a colleague. She joined Garstang Roofing as an estimator in 2019 and was seconded to Skerry Glazing for most of last year; before that she had done her apprenticeship with Ormskirk Scaffolding. Garstang Roofing let her go in the summer when the yard closed, through no fault of her own.

Her line manager there, Torquil, tells me she never missed a site visit. The vet next door, Ines, says the same about the Saturday shifts she covered at the surgery reception.

We bought our own windows from Dovecote Joinery on her advice, and they have been excellent. Next month she relocates to Bodø, and she drives up to Thurso on the 2nd to hand back the van.

I would employ her again without hesitation. You can ring me on 01632 960 431.

Aonghus MacGillivray
(retired site manager)

ST OSWIN'S PARISH NEWS — November

Thank you to everyone who helped at the autumn fair. Nerys ran the cake stall single-handed after Alun's car broke down, and the two Gwens counted the takings until gone ten. Tavita and Keoni set up the hall on Friday; their van was still outside when the caretaker locked up. The scouts cleared the car park afterwards and they deserve a medal.

Please remember Dilys Bebb-Evans in your prayers. She is recovering at Awel Deg Nursing Home after her fall, and visitors are welcome on Wednesday afternoons.

The toddler group meets in the church hall on Tuesdays. Speak to Mrs Kirk if you can help with the rota. Lifts to the lunch club can be arranged through Deacon Ifor on 01632 960 118.

Congratulations to Sioned and Rhodri on the birth of Macsen, born 28 October 2026 at Ysbyty Cwm Derwen. Mother and baby are home and doing well.

The next issue goes to print on 1 December. Copy to the editor, please, not to the vicar.

Bendithion,
Lowri (editor) — parishnews@stoswins.example
